scene: The unrolled painted scroll reveals three routes leading out of the valley.
picture: A close-up view through the player's eyes of the delicate silk scroll held open by two brown-sleeved hands. The silk map depicts whimsical transit paths: up high is a suspended red cable tram, along the bottom left drifts a flat river barge, and on the lower right stands an emerald glass-roofed trolley.
shown: a painted aerial cable tram icon perched up high on the scroll
an ink drawing of a wide river barge along the bottom left
an illustrated green glass-roofed trolley sketch sitting on the lower right
